rows.text: stores `xmm2` and `xmm3` in the third- and fourth-argument home slots and calls `0075AE30(rcx, &third slot, &fourth slot)` with `xmm1` also in `xmm4`, keeping `k` = `ecx` in `r10d` across the call; maps `k` 3, 5, 7, 9, 0xB, 0xC, 0xD and 0xF to 2, 4, 6, 8, 0xA, 1, 0xA and 0xE; any other `k` above 0xE (unsigned) goes to image base + 0x609A58; then dispatches on `k` through the jump table at image base + `0x609A60`: 0 and 1 to image base + 0x609A58, 2 and 4 to image base + 0x609A3A, 6 and 8 to `007299D5`, 0xA to image base + 0x6099ED and 0xE to image base + 0x609A52; the listed extent ends with the first instruction at `007299D5`, which loads the fourth-argument slot float into `xmm2`
